participant: One Codex coding assistant already familiar with both workflows, all prior code and study outcomes. No human participant, blinding, independent author or general productivity inference.
purpose: Prospective familiarized reimplementation time after shared validator repairs, supplementing rather than replacing the original confounded implementation episodes.
task: In a previously absent episode-specific producer, implement reusable full-data mean/sample-SD PNG/SVG/PDF figures for all nine NIST datasets in publisher order, with the exact frozen v2 labels/numerical/physical/export gates. Same --dataset/--data/--out-dir/--variant producer interface as the original study; clean mean_sd variant. Producer reads all source observations and computes summaries without reference-answer lookup.
authoring_rules: Write new producer source after live begin; do not copy an existing producer file or use an arm-specific prepared source generator. Library APIs, documentation, remembered patterns and the already known task are allowed. Record this prior familiarity; these are not first-use timings. Format/lint source inside its episode before verification and keep it unchanged afterward.
clock: UTC and same-host/boot monotonic begin before producer-specific lookup/editing, end only after all nine clean cases verify and exact output/source retention passes. Include failed subject attempts, tool calls, linting and validation. Do not do CI, vault maintenance, unrelated work or shared harness changes during an episode; interruption/shared repair invalidates interpretation and must be disclosed without deleting/resetting it.
order: Round1 GraphUnslopify then Matplotlib; round2 Matplotlib then GraphUnslopify. Run all four irrespective of outcomes. These are repeated episodes by one familiar operator, not independent subjects.
preflight: Before starting any new clock, verify both existing canonical producers on all nine datasets using the exact new producer-path route and unchanged frozen v2 verifier. Retain all18 preflight records. No new episode producer may exist before its begin.
shared_cost: Prior design, familiarity, shared harness/validation preparation and CI outside episodes are unmeasured/excluded. Report this plus authored/payload/generated code footprints separately. Fresh processes use warm caches; total wall time is agent-task time, not CPU rendering time.
failure_policy: No changing cases, numeric tolerances, quality gates, source data or shared implementation during live episodes. Preserve every attempt and prior v1/v2 outcome. An amended/interrupted/shared-repair episode cannot be used as a clean paired timing; no retrospective times or stopping on a favorable result.
reporting: Retain four raw episode times, both per-round pairings, all failures, source hashes and actual outputs. A completed unamended study permits this limited familiar-agent timing description; it establishes neither causal/human productivity nor broader independent researcher benefit. Do not require GraphUnslopify to win.
